title: parosela leporina var. thouinii
intro: Parosela leporina var. thouinii, commonly known as the "Balsam of Tolu," is a plant-based remedy extracted from the Myroxylon balsamum tree, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Parosela leporina var. thouinii include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include resin, volatile oils, and phenolic compounds, such as tolu balsam, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
